And then, make an effort to go to the east. And then, venture north. Then, make an attempt to venture north. After that, move west. After that, venture north. After that, head west. Once you finish that, go to the north. Next, make an attempt to go north. That done, head east. Then, attempt to travel south. Okay, and then, travel east. And then, head east. And then, travel east.
